portraits.CorruptedElf:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent front portrait for a cube enemy in an existing 2D anime chibi tower-defense game.
References: image 1 (Valkyrie) is ONLY a reference for illustration style, small character occupancy and frontal portrait layout. Create a NEW ELF character, not another Valkyrie.
Design brief from game plan: Stage 2 Alfheim, ordinary enemy "Corrupted Elf". It is the lowest rank in a three-rank enemy family (ordinary elf, clan captain, high chieftain). Alfheim is an elven forest of pale leaf-green light and withered leaves. All three ranks remain readable as small square cube-face portraits.
Subject: one youthful elf scout with clearly visible long pointed ears, short softly tousled ash-blond hair, subtle leaf-shaped side clip, amethyst-purple eyes and a calm but slightly hostile expression. A small discreet purple corruption mark near one cheek. Pale natural skin; no gore. A simple silver-white leaf clasp at the collar, short neutral charcoal-gray hood resting behind the head (not covering hair), modest silver-gray leaf-shaped shoulder armor over a light neutral tunic. Keep silhouette compact and ordinary, no crown, antlers, horns or giant wings. Silver equipment must be neutral gray/white, so the game can recolor it later; skin and hair retain their own colors.
Style: match the existing game portraits: polished 2D anime SD, thin clean dark lineart, smooth restrained cel shading, elegant small highlights, clean natural eyes with one pupil each. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic.
Layout: square transparent canvas. EXACT front view, symmetrical head and shoulders, one isolated character. Whole visible bust confined approximately to x=11..89 percent and y=25..97 percent of the canvas, centered; substantial transparent top margin like the reference. Hair, ears and shoulders all inside this footprint. Bottom chest edge at 97 percent. Character must not fill the entire image or be oversized. No background, scene, tile, frame, badge, text, labels or watermark. Genuine transparent alpha.
